markers.description: Part of speech (word class in parentheses such as 'a', 'ad', 'v', 'par', 'n').
Paaradigm (grammatical category in parentheses such as 'm.', 'f.', 'f.s.', 'm.s.').

rules: Entry boundary: Each new lexical entry begins with \lx.
Homographs: Use separate \lx blocks with the same lemma, appending \hm 1, \hm 2 to distinguish them if necessary.
Senses: If a word has multiple distinct meanings, sequence them using \sn 1, \sn 2, each followed by its own \ge gloss.
Subentries: For derived forms (e.g. female singular and plural) listed under a main entry, use \se followed by \pd and \pl within the parent \lx block.
Gloss lines: Use \ge for the English equivalent; separate multiple English synonyms with commas or semicolons within the same \ge field.
Orthography: The Perso-Arabic script is printed alongside the Roman \lx, which can be stored as a variant form (e.g., \va), while standard MDF formatting relies on \lx.
